bounded_authority: Only the source-bound publication/promotion configs and new editorial records were authored. This is a root-facing adapter specification, not a mutation of a shared renderer, schema or site.

field_mapping.title: HTML h1, document title and citation_title; exact published title
field_mapping.description: Unique meta description, Open Graph description and ScholarlyArticle.description
field_mapping.abstract: Full unchanged original abstract in indexable HTML and ScholarlyArticle.abstract
field_mapping.abstract_heading: Use Original abstract as the visible heading. The current shared renderer hardcodes Abstract and ignores this field. Root must make a bounded per-page adaptation and verify actual output; do not prefix, shorten or rewrite the abstract to work around the heading.
field_mapping.ai_disclosure: Status and AI use; extensive AI/unrefereed/no human or journal review/no formal certification must survive
field_mapping.edition_note: Display the declared manuscript/publication date separately from record-created date; do not infer priority
field_mapping.background: Linked credited prior work, without adopting unverified absence/example-overlap assertions from manuscript Section 5
field_mapping.collaboration: Actual substantive research and writing contributions plus mutual agreement; no prepared individual outreach
field_mapping.canonical_url: Already the final slug-derived canonical; use it in canonical tag, structured data, citation_pdf_url, Open Graph, index and sitemap when actually staged
field_mapping.source_binding: Private source identity/custody; not public prose
field_mapping.review_metadata: Private preparation state; not public prose

custom_verdict_requirements.root_authority: promotion.status PASS is the later root scientific disposition, bound to the exact root-clearance hash; it is not a live/browser/native-publication pass.
custom_verdict_requirements.scope_original: Preserve the complete reviews.scope.verdict object including status=SCOPE_COMPLETE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_MATHEMATICAL_REVIEW, mathematical_pass=false, scientific_verdict=null, defect_found=null and ready_to_publish=false. The frozen candidate retains mathematical_pass=false, ready_to_publish=false and canonical_url=null.
custom_verdict_requirements.analytic_original: Preserve complete original object: status=analytic_pass_no_substantive_defect_found, publication_clearance=false and remaining_analytic_gap=null. Root disposition is separately PASS.
custom_verdict_requirements.adversarial_original: Preserve complete original object: verdict=PASS_SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE, substantive_defect_found=false and unresolved_mathematical_gap=null. Root disposition is separately PASS.
custom_verdict_requirements.bounded_mapping: Read each complete original object and its separately copied root_disposition. Do not rewrite source verdicts or turn the scope-only pending gate into an original mathematical PASS. Later root scope_gate_resolution explains chronology.

asset_specification.pdf: Copy support_slit.pdf from the bound sources without modification; iframe/embed uses the identical local asset. Provide a direct-open link and a download link with a download attribute, plus a clear original Zenodo link. Do not regenerate the PDF.
asset_specification.supplement: Copy the complete verification_package.zip unchanged; provide local download and Zenodo original links. Do not extract/trim/repack it as the public supplement.
asset_specification.no_other_assets: No additional reader or public third-party cached primary texts. The ZIP contains no embedded PDF reader or nested archive.
asset_specification.download_adapter: The shared renderer currently offers direct PDF opening and the original Zenodo link but no explicit local PDF download attribute. Root should include that bounded per-page link and verify it with the final assets. The separate supporting-material links in PUBLIC_COPY must be carried through even though related_resources is empty.
